defects: Drops the `IsFinitelySemisimple f` hypothesis entirely, which is essential to the theorem's truth — without it the iff is false in general (e.g. a nontrivial nilpotent Jordan block on K^2 has generalized eigenspace at 0 equal to the whole space but ordinary eigenspace at 0 only 1-dimensional, so LHS holds and RHS fails)
Restricts to a Field K and FiniteDimensional V instead of the gold's general CommRing R / AddCommGroup M / Module R M setting, an unjustified narrowing of scope

Uses Submodule.span K (⋃ ...) instead of the iSup-of-submodules form; this reformulation is mathematically equivalent (span of a union of submodules equals their supremum), so not itself a defect, but does not compensate for the missing hypothesis
